tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, warm paper. Carries ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle, primary and brand text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies, inputs. Carries every text token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, input wells, code and tx-hash chips. ink and ink-muted only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: table row rules, dividers, inner borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Ecru. Outline of cards, tables and the DvP receipt and of their second layer; rules under table headers. Decorative, not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 on bg and surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units (USDC) on bg, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, timestamps on bg and surface.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Dark Medici Blue. Primary buttons, links, active tab, focus ring. Text on surface and bg.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, info alert ground.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Hay's Russet. Logo wordmark, APR figures, the one key number per screen. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for brand text in tags and highlights.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Olive Ocher. Yield bars, featured-offer marker, health meter fill. Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Featured offer ground, yield highlight.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Text on gold-soft and on surface where gold meaning is needed.

tokens.name: healthy
tokens.usage: Status Open / healthy. Text on healthy-soft and surface.

tokens.name: healthy-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Open status pill.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Status MarginCall. Text on margin-soft and surface.

tokens.name: margin-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the MarginCall pill and alert.

tokens.name: defaulted
tokens.usage: Status Defaulted and Liquidated, errors. Text on defaulted-soft and surface.

tokens.name: defaulted-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Defaulted pill and error alert.

tokens.name: repaid
tokens.usage: Status Repaid. Text on repaid-soft and surface.

tokens.name: repaid-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Repaid pill.

tokens.name: wada-russet
tokens.usage: Source color: Hay's Russet (Wada No. 249). Reference only, use brand.

tokens.name: wada-ecru
tokens.usage: Source color: Ecru (Wada No. 249). Reference and cover only.

tokens.name: wada-ocher
tokens.usage: Source color: Olive Ocher (Wada No. 249). Reference only, use gold.

tokens.name: wada-medici
tokens.usage: Source color: Dark Medici Blue (Wada No. 249). Reference only, use primary.

families.display: "EB Garamond", Garamond, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and deck titles only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lock tBENJI and receive USDC in the same transaction.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, button text.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Margin window: 2 minutes in demo mode

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The hero amount on a card or page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts, rates, NAV, countdowns in tables and cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between fields, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

radius.note: Caravel has no rounded corners. Every card, button, field, chip and bar is square.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: All corners. Do not round anything except the logo.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating elements only: popovers, modals, the take-offer sheet. Cards use a line border instead.

frame.note: The double layer: a second sheet offset to the bottom and right, outlined in the same rule, like a stacked certificate.

tokens.name: frame-rule
tokens.usage: Width of the outline on the element and on its second layer.

tokens.name: frame-offset
tokens.usage: How far the second layer sits to the bottom and right. Buttons travel this far when pressed.
